project: Wuxia Life P48 Sample Lines Player-Facing Expression
description: Plan the lightweight player-facing expression work that turns three configured 0-40 sample lines into readable current goals, consequence signals, and age-40 identity summaries using existing summary, route-signal, and life-memory surfaces instead of a UI rebuild.

userStories.title: Audit existing player-facing surfaces for the three sample lines
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a focused audit of current player-facing expression surfaces so P48 fills the real readability gaps instead of adding parallel presentation layers.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory current summary, life-memory, route-signal, and long-term-impact surfaces
Mark current coverage and gaps for all three sample lines
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/
Do not change gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Define orthodox martial summary expression tasks
userStories.description: As a planner, I want the orthodox line’s player-facing expression decomposed into small tasks so implementation can strengthen readability without broad UI redesign.
acceptanceCriteria: Split current-goal expression for the orthodox line into a standalone task
Split upright-cost expression for the orthodox line into a standalone task
Split age-40 identity summary expression for the orthodox line into a standalone task
Ensure each task fits in one implementation iteration

userStories.title: Define demonic edge summary expression tasks
userStories.description: As a planner, I want the demonic line’s player-facing expression decomposed into small tasks so temptation and backlash become legible without adding a new evil dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Split temptation expression for the demonic line into a standalone task
Split post-transgression fallout expression for the demonic line into a standalone task
Split age-40 identity summary expression for the demonic line into a standalone task
Ensure each task fits in one implementation iteration

userStories.title: Define merchant rise summary expression tasks
userStories.description: As a planner, I want the merchant line’s player-facing expression decomposed into small tasks so wealth, leverage, and obligation become legible without business-specific UI expansion.
acceptanceCriteria: Split current-goal expression for the merchant line into a standalone task
Split debt, loyalty, or risk expression for the merchant line into a standalone task
Split age-40 identity summary expression for the merchant line into a standalone task
Ensure each task fits in one implementation iteration

userStories.title: Define cross-line current-goal expression rules
userStories.description: As a player, I want to know what my current life direction is so I can intentionally continue or pivot the sample line I am building.
acceptanceCriteria: Define shared current-goal expression rules across all three lines
Avoid exposing raw internal keys
Support graceful fallback before a line is fully formed
Record the rules in the PRD

userStories.title: Define cross-line cost and fallout expression rules
userStories.description: As a player, I want important costs and fallout to feel like real consequences so sample-line choices do not read as bookkeeping only.
acceptanceCriteria: Define shared long-term cost and fallout expression rules across all three lines
Cover some combination of debt, enemies, opportunities, reputation, and sacrifice
Prefer existing long-term-impact surfaces
Record the rules in the PRD
userStories.notes: PRD §14 Cross-Line Cost And Fallout Expression Rules

userStories.title: Define age-40 identity summary rules
userStories.description: As a player, I want age-40 summary language to clearly tell me what kind of person I became so each sample line lands as a memorable life type.
acceptanceCriteria: Define age-40 identity summary rules for each of the three lines
Tie each summary to that line’s core goal and cost source
Keep tone consistent while preserving clear content differences
Record the rules in the PRD

userStories.title: Define lightweight surface mapping
userStories.description: As a developer, I want explicit mapping from required expression to existing surfaces so implementation stays narrow and avoids accidental UX expansion.
acceptanceCriteria: Map which information belongs on main screen summary
Map which information belongs on route signal or long-term impact
Map which information belongs on life-memory or age-40 summary
Mark what remains out of scope for this stage

userStories.title: Define P48 closure evidence
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want explicit closure evidence for the player-facing expression stage so later validation work knows what should already be visible to a human tester.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the closure evidence required for the readability stage
Define the minimum human spot-check items
Define which expression gaps block entry into P49
Record the closure rules in the PRD
userStories.notes: PRD §17 P48 Closure Evidence; aligns with P46 §11.2
